**DK26.2** is a specific medical diagnosis code representing an acute duodenal ulcer with hemorrhage and perforation ("akut duodenalulcus med blødning og perforation") [^src1]. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's national quality monitoring, this code plays a critical role in tracking adverse events among patients treated for [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1].

Specifically, DK26.2 is utilized as part of the clinical quality indicator measuring the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) in the atrial fibrillation patient population [^src3]. The annual reports from the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) consistently include this code in their methodological definitions for identifying severe bleeding complications across the 2023, 2024, and 2025 reporting periods [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. 

To accurately capture the incidence of severe bleeding, the AFDK (Atrieflimren i Danmark) database employs a comprehensive array of diagnostic codes. DK26.2 is categorized under the broader umbrella of gastrointestinal bleeding codes, which span from DK25.0 to DK29.8A and DK92.0 to DK92.2 [^src1]. This gastrointestinal category is used alongside codes for intracranial bleeding (DI60–DS066) and urinary/respiratory bleeding (DJ942, DN02, DR04, DR31) to ensure a complete epidemiological picture of bleeding complications in these patients [^src1].
